values: What has already been changed or fixed in the PAWJAI system.
Moved admin access from passphrase/cookie to Supabase Auth role checks.
Added admin, shelter_admin, and adopter role support through profiles and shelter_users.
Shelter admins can manage only linked shelter records; global admins keep full workspace access.
Created a shared admin/shelter login screen with email and password fields.
Global admins can create/revoke global and shelter admin accounts from the admin UI.
Admin actions now write audit events; admins can review /admin/audit.
Rate limits added to auth, admin login, bookings, documents, donations, and appointment messages.
Created audit events, rate-limit buckets, booking guard index, and advisor security fixes.
Set function search_path and removed broad public storage listing policies.
Added stable docs for future Codex/Claude work to reduce context and token waste.
Deleted stale duplicate page/test/client files and corrupt build artifacts.
Replaced deprecated middleware.ts with proxy.ts for Next 16 compatibility.
Repo now has one command for typecheck, tests, lint, and high-severity audit.
